subject.title: feat(code-mode): unify node MCP servers into the MCP namespace

question: Should Code Mode intentionally remove node-backed MCP tools from the existing generic `tools.*` and `ALL_TOOLS` surfaces in favor of the typed `MCP.<server>.*` namespace?
rationale: The branch presents the removal as part of unification, but whether existing Code Mode programs may rely on the prior surface is a maintainer-owned compatibility and product-contract decision.

options.title: Keep a transition path
options.body: Retain the generic node-MCP access path temporarily or provide a clear compatibility mechanism while introducing the typed namespace.

options.title: Make the namespace break intentional
options.body: Approve removal of the generic path only with explicit upgrade documentation and fresh-install plus upgrade proof showing the expected Code Mode behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep a transition path
recommendation.body: Retain the generic node-MCP access path temporarily or provide a clear compatibility mechanism while introducing the typed namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR context assigns this person to the proposal, though current-main ownership history still needs confirmation.
